C07 and C10 contain similar report-and-appreciation structures but are less closely aligned throughout.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I look forward to having the benefit of your recommendations.","parent_excerpt":"to have the benefit of the continued counsel of the National Security Training Commission","explanation":"Both anticipate using a commission's expert work in forthcoming governmental decisions."},{"child_excerpt":"The time, thought, and energy that you are putting into this program as Chairman of the Commission","parent_excerpt":"the long hours of effort that you and your associates have contributed in the preparation of the excellent report","explanation":"Both commend sustained personal effort by the commission leader and colleagues."},{"child_excerpt":"Please convey to them my personal appreciation of their willingness to serve in this manner.","parent_excerpt":"May I as well convey my personal regards to you and to each member of your Commission.","explanation":"Both close the appreciation theme by extending the President's sentiments to the commission's other participants."}]}
